## Problem and result

Explain the concrete problem and what changes for readers or future users.

## Evidence and validation

List primary sources, commands run, and results. Label estimates and hypotheses. Include raw data for any performance claim and explain tests not run.

## Compatibility, safety, and licensing

For future kernel-facing changes, identify kernel/config/toolchain, load and recovery results, resource bounds, and SPDX/provenance. For documentation changes, note any status or interface changes.
